town_description: Seppa is the headquarters town of East Kameng district in western Arunachal Pradesh, on the Kameng river in the Eastern Himalayan foothills. A remote market town serving surrounding tribal villages, it hosts the Ramakrishna Mission school at nearby Lumdung and Hindu mandirs (including a Shiva Mandir where RKM monks have observed Maha Shivaratri), with road access via NH-13.

travel.airport: Salonibari (Tezpur) Airport, Assam, about 86 km away; Donyi Polo Airport (Itanagar/Hollongi) is also used for the region.
travel.railway: Bhalukpong (about 63 km) is the nearest station in Arunachal; Rangapara North Junction (~79 km) and Harmuti Junction (~93 km) in Assam serve long-distance trains.
travel.road: Seppa lies on NH-13; reachable by road from Itanagar and Tezpur via taxis and buses.
